notes: the opening «وقد روي عن النبي» is al-Tirmidhi's lead-in; the chain follows at «حدثنا بذلك قتيبة» and carries the same saying
«عبد الرحمن مولى قيس»: «مولى قيس» is an epithet and is left out of the surface
the closing «بهذا» marks the matn, not an earlier chain in this text; it is not written as a back reference
